dialogue.origin: こんばんは
dialogue.content: Good evening.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。どうぞ、よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Good evening. It's a pleasure to meet you.

dialogue.origin: 今日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you for seeing me today.

dialogue.origin: お時間前ですが、始めさせていただいても、よろしいですか？
dialogue.content: We're a little early, but is it alright if we begin?

dialogue.origin: はい、大丈夫です。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。では、よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you. Then, let’s begin.

dialogue.origin: お願いいたします
dialogue.content: Yes, please.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。相談員です。今日は、どのようなお悩みで来られましたか？
dialogue.content: Good evening. I'm your counselor. What brings you in today?

dialogue.origin: ペットを巡っての話しなのですが、どうしても父を許す事が出来ず憎んでいます
dialogue.content: It's about my pet. I just can't forgive my father, and I hate him.

dialogue.origin: ペットを飼われているのですね。ご相談者様のことを何とお呼びしたらよいでしょうか？ニックネームでもいいので、教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: You have a pet, I see. What would you like me to call you? A nickname is fine, if you'd prefer.

dialogue.origin: 彩です
dialogue.content: It's Aya.

dialogue.origin: 彩さん、お父さんを許すことができないとのことですが、ペットを巡ってお父様との間に何があるか具体的に教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Aya, you mentioned that you can't forgive your father. Could you tell me specifically what happened between you and him regarding your pet?

dialogue.origin: 犬なのですが、カミナリが大嫌いな子で、カミナリがなると家族にしがみついてくるのですが
dialogue.content: It's my dog. He's terrified of thunder, and whenever it thunders, he clings to a family member.

dialogue.origin: カミナリは怖いですよね、犬は駆け回り落ち付かない犬が多いかと思いますが・・・
dialogue.content: Thunder can be frightening. I imagine many dogs get restless and run around...

dialogue.origin: たまたま誰も家におらず、同じ敷地内に住む父の所に逃げ込んだ様なのですが
dialogue.content: It just so happened that no one was home, and he seems to have run to my father's place, which is on the same property.

dialogue.origin: 犬はしっかり逃げ場を見つけて逃げ込んだのですね
dialogue.content: So the dog smartly found a place to escape to.

dialogue.origin: 父は、勢いよく入って来た犬に驚いた様で、丸めた新聞紙で殴って追い出してしまい
dialogue.content: My father was apparently startled by the dog bursting in, so he hit him with a rolled-up newspaper and chased him out.

dialogue.origin: 驚いたお父様に殴られた犬は、その後、どんな様子でしたか？
dialogue.content: After being hit by your startled father, what was the dog like?

dialogue.origin: 私達が帰宅すると、逃げられる様な高さでは無い塀を乗り越えて逃げてしまい半年経った今も見つかっていません
dialogue.content: When we got home, he had escaped by jumping over a fence that shouldn't have been possible to climb, and even now, six months later, we haven't found him.

dialogue.origin: 高い塀を乗り越えて逃げ出し、今も見つかっていないということなんですね。彩さんは半年間犬を探し続けているのですね、
dialogue.content: So he jumped over a high fence and ran away, and still hasn't been found. You've been searching for your dog for six months, haven't you, Aya?

dialogue.origin: はい、保健所にも行きましたしビラも配ったのですが。もう、父が憎くて憎くて！
dialogue.content: Yes, I've been to the animal shelters and handed out flyers. I just hate my father so, so much!

dialogue.origin: 本当にお辛い半年をお過ごしなんですね。お父様を憎んでいるのは無理もありません。お父様は犬がいなくなったことを、どんな風に感じていらっしゃるかわかりますか？
dialogue.content: It sounds like these past six months have been truly painful. It's understandable that you hate your father. Do you have a sense of how he feels about the dog being gone?

dialogue.origin: 俺が悪いんじゃない。と開き直ってます
dialogue.content: He's defiant, saying, "It's not my fault."

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、開き直っているお父様をみると彩さんは余計許せない気持ちになったりしますか？
dialogue.content: I see. And seeing your father being so defiant makes it even harder for you to forgive him, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: 殺してやりたい位憎いです
dialogue.content: I hate him so much I could kill him.

dialogue.origin: 彩さんは、お父様を殺してやりたいと思うくらい愛情をかけてかわいがっていたのですね。
dialogue.content: You must have loved and cared for your pet so deeply that it makes you feel like you could kill your father.

dialogue.origin: 犬をですよね？
dialogue.content: You mean the dog, right?

dialogue.origin: 失礼しました。はい、犬をです。愛情いっぱいかけ、散歩もし、家族として犬を飼われていたのですよね。
dialogue.content: My apologies. Yes, I mean the dog. You gave him lots of love, took him for walks, and he was a member of the family, wasn't he?

dialogue.origin: そうですね父以外、祖母も母も子供2人も嘆き悲しんでいます
dialogue.content: That's right. Everyone except my father—my grandmother, my mother, and my two children—is grieving deeply.

dialogue.origin: みんなの愛情をいっぱい受けていた犬が本当に心配ですね。そして、その犬がいなくなり、本当にお辛い毎日が続いていますね。彩さんは、お父様のことをもし許すとしたら、、、と考えたことはありますか？
dialogue.content: It must be so worrying, thinking about the dog that received so much love from everyone. And with him gone, your days must be so painful. Aya, have you ever considered what it might take for you to forgive your father?

dialogue.origin: 考えた事はありますが、これが初めてでは無いので余計憎く思います
dialogue.content: I've thought about it, but this isn't the first time, which makes me hate him all the more.

dialogue.origin: 初めてではない、、、以前にも、お辛いことがあったのですか？
dialogue.content: Not the first time... Has something painful like this happened before?

dialogue.origin: 鳥を逃してしまいましたその子も行方不明のままです
dialogue.content: He let our bird escape. That one is still missing, too.

dialogue.origin: 鳥も、、、ですか、、、その子も行方不明とは、悲しい出来事が続いたのですね。それで、お父様のことが余計憎い、、、それは、悲しみ、怒り、寂しさ、辛さ、、、、言葉にならないことが重なっていますね。
dialogue.content: A bird, too... And that one is also missing. It's been one sad event after another. That's why you hate your father even more... It sounds like layers of grief, anger, loneliness, and pain—all the things that are hard to put into words—are piling up.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 「俺が悪いんじゃない」というお父様と辛さを共有したことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Have you ever tried to share your pain with your father, the one who says, "It's not my fault"?

dialogue.origin: ないですね
dialogue.content: No, I haven't.

dialogue.origin: もしかしたら、一番お困りはお父様かもしれませんが、そのような話をされてみたらいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Perhaps your father is the one who is most troubled by this. How about trying to talk to him about it from that perspective?

dialogue.origin: 最初は責める気は無く説明を求めたのですが、勢いよく入って来た犬が悪い。勝手に逃げ出した鳥が悪い。と言うので。
dialogue.content: At first, I wasn't trying to blame him; I just asked for an explanation. But he said, 'The dog that barged in is at fault. The bird that flew off on its own is at fault.'

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、彩さん。せめる気持ちはなかったのですよね。お父様も本当は、どうにかしたいのに、どうにもならない気持ちを「俺が悪いんじゃない」と一言言ってしまったために後に引けない状況が生まれ、それが続いているのかもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: I understand, Aya. You weren't trying to blame him. It may be that your father, too, truly wanted to make things right but felt helpless, and by saying, 'It's not my fault,' he's boxed himself into a corner, and that dynamic has just continued.

dialogue.origin: そうなんでしょうけど、だからこそ謝罪の言葉が出て来ないから許せないままでいるんです
dialogue.content: That might be the case, but that's precisely why I can't forgive him—because he won't apologize.

dialogue.origin: もし謝罪の言葉があったら、彩さんはお父様を許せますか？
dialogue.content: If he were to apologize, do you think you could forgive him?

dialogue.origin: 出て来ない事には、私の感情もどう変化するかは分かりません
dialogue.content: Until he actually says it, I don't know how my feelings would change.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね、その時にならないと気持ちの変化はわからないですよね。その複雑なお気持ちよくわかります。しかし、このままでは、憎しみが続くだけで、彩さんもお辛いかと思うのですが、お父様と話をするきっかけを作る前向きなお手伝いをさせていただきたいのですが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: That's true, you can't know how you'll feel until it happens. I understand those complex feelings. However, if things stay as they are, the hatred will just continue, and I imagine that's painful for you. I would like to help you find a constructive way to create an opportunity to talk with your father. How does that sound?

dialogue.origin: お願いします憎む感情を抱えたままでは私も前に進めなく辛いです
dialogue.content: Yes, please. As long as I'm holding onto this hatred, I can't move forward, and it's painful.

dialogue.origin: 彩さん、本当に、辛い日々をお過ごしでしたよね。そして、よく頑張ってこられましたね。時には、お父様を憎まなければいけない自分を責めることがあったかもしれません。しかし優しいお父様思いの彩さんだから、前に進めなくてつらかったんだと思います。
dialogue.content: Aya, you have truly been going through some difficult days. And you've done so well to get through them. At times, you may have even blamed yourself for having to hate your father. But I think it's because you are a kind person who cares for your father that you've found it so painful not to be able to move forward.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございますでも父とは元々不仲なので父思いではありません
dialogue.content: Thank you, but my father and I have always had a strained relationship, so I don't care about him in that way.

dialogue.origin: そうですか、元々不仲なんですね。不仲なお父様ですが、犬のことをきっかけに、彩さんの気持ちを伝えると、もしかしたら彩さんの知らないお父様の本心や考えを聞くことができるのかもしれませんが、何か話をするきっかけを見つけることはできますか？
dialogue.content: I see, so you've never gotten along. Even so, if you use the situation with the dog as an opportunity to convey your feelings, you might be able to hear your father's true thoughts and feelings that you weren't aware of. Can you think of any way to start a conversation?

dialogue.origin: 話しはしてますよお父さんの言い分もあるだろうけど、一言悪かった。とは言って貰えませんか？と言いましたが、何で悪く無いものを謝る必要があるんだ！と怒鳴られました
dialogue.content: I have talked to him. I said, "I'm sure you have your side of the story, but couldn't you just say you're sorry?" But he just yelled at me, "Why should I have to apologize for something that wasn't my fault!"

dialogue.origin: そうだったんですね、そのようなお父様の怒鳴り声を聞いて彩さんはどのように感じましたか？
dialogue.content: I see, so that's what happened. How did you feel when your father yelled at you like that?

dialogue.origin: 殺してやりたい！ですね
dialogue.content: I felt like I wanted to kill him!

dialogue.origin: 怒鳴られると、そういう感情になるのは無理もありません、、、彩さんの殺してやりたい、憎んでいるという感情が消えませんね。しかしその感情を持ち続けることで、また彩さんが苦しみ続けている気がしますが、そうではありませんか？
dialogue.content: It's understandable to feel that way when you're yelled at... Your feelings of wanting to kill him and hating him aren't going away. But holding onto those emotions seems to be causing you ongoing suffering, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: Yes, it does.

dialogue.origin: お父様は不器用で素直でないために、謝る言葉を発したいのに、発せない、、、だから怒鳴るという行為で、その言葉に表せない感情を示しているかもしれませんね。そんな風に考えるのは難しいですか？
dialogue.content: Your father may be awkward and not very straightforward, so perhaps he wants to apologize but can't... and so he yells as a way to express those feelings he can't put into words. Is it difficult to think of it that way?

dialogue.origin: 必ずしも理解し合う事が解決なんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Is mutual understanding necessarily the solution?

dialogue.origin: 理解しあうことだけが解決ではないかもしれません。
dialogue.content: Mutual understanding may not be the only path to resolution.

dialogue.origin: 私はこの憎しみと言う感情から解き放たれたいんです
dialogue.content: I just want to be freed from this feeling of hatred.

dialogue.origin: 不仲で来たのには歴史があるんですよねそんな簡単に話し合って理解し合える訳が無いんです
dialogue.content: There's a whole history behind why we don't get along. There's no way we can just talk it out and easily understand each other.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、今まで、いろいろな感情を持ちながら家族として暮らしてきたんですものね。理解し合おうと思うと無理があるかもしれませんね。しかし、憎しみという感情から放たれる近道は、彩さんが今のお父様（今までのお父様）をそのまま受け入れることが大切かもしれません。
dialogue.content: That's true. You've lived together as a family while holding onto all sorts of emotions all this time. It might be asking too much to expect to reach a mutual understanding. However, the shortcut to being freed from this feeling of hatred might be for you to accept your father just as he is now, and as he has been.

dialogue.origin: 相談員さん、ごめんなさい何だか、こうあるべき。こうあって欲しい。と言う押し付けに感じてしまい一生懸命私を理解してくれた後に、しかし、ですが。が来ると悲しくなります
dialogue.content: Counselor, I'm sorry, but it feels like you're pushing a "you should be this way" or "I want you to be this way" idea onto me. After you try so hard to understand me, hearing a "however" or a "but" makes me sad.

dialogue.origin: そのように感じてしまう言葉を使ってしまったのですね。ごめんなさい。反省しています。
dialogue.content: I see my words made you feel that way. I'm sorry. I will reflect on that.

dialogue.origin: （お時間になりましたので終了しましょうか？）
dialogue.content: (Our time is up, shall we end the session?)

dialogue.origin: （ありがとうございました。うまく話をすすめられず、申し訳ありませんでした）
dialogue.content: (Thank you very much. I apologize for not being able to guide the conversation well.)

dialogue.origin: （大変お疲れさまでした。ありがとうございます。又、お会いした時はよろしくお願いいたします）
dialogue.content: (You must be tired. Thank you very much. I look forward to working with you again.)

dialogue.origin: （では、失礼いたします）
dialogue.content: (Well then, excuse me.)

dialogue.origin: （大変お疲れ様でした。とても勉強になりました。こちらこそ、また、よろしくお願いいたします。ロールプレイ終了ボタンを押しますね。本当に、ありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your hard work. This was a great learning experience. Likewise, I look forward to working with you again. I'll press the role-play end button now. Thank you so much.)

topic.sub: 父との許しあえない関係
